faces.transcription: Destroy both objectives for this month. Find cards 86 and 87 in the Operations deck. Use these two new objectives for the second half of April.
faces.flavor:
"Well, shoot, this one got away from us. It ain't gonna be easy, but there's still a chance to get back out and clean some of it up.
Now, I don't want you to get nervous, but brass is gonna be keepin' a real close eye on this operation. Heck, I noticed someone tailin' me the other day. Nothin' to worry about, though; oversight like this comes with the territory."
